derived_from: C29 one-pass generation; C32 raw-history packets. C34 changes only the opening style sentence.
planned_scope: Two contexts, two prompt conditions, two fresh repeats: eight first continuations, eight author tasks, zero fresh long sessions.
change: Opening sentence requests naturalistic interactive fiction in the prose/dialogue register of a contemporary literary novel. All remaining instructions, full Covenant and raw context stay exact. No named-author or character dialogue example, voice lexicon, or reduced biography.
loop: Each fresh whole-story Terra/max author reads its common instructions, full Covenant/persona, complete published history and current player input, then returns one first continuation. No editor or selector.
review_contract: Root locks its full-output assessment before a fresh anonymous comparison against original context. Retain all eight first outputs. Assess whole exchanges, lived interaction, particular interests and player scope.
delivery_format: Both conditions end request files with a newline so wc -l includes the output-path line. No story instruction changes accompany this technical formatting correction.
limits: This is a bounded positive-register hypothesis, not documented model-specific guidance. The label may flatten setting-specific formality, change narration more than speech, or have little effect. No long-session, API-equivalence or model-ceiling claim.
